meta.subject: Squeak
meta.stack: static HTML + local GSAP 3.15.0 / ScrollTrigger, no Lenis
meta.status: built and revised after parent review; measured in Chromium

motion.reducedMotion: degrade: no pin, no entrances, no duck movement; all states are static content
motion.pinFallback: motion.js measures every state inside the pinned layout; if copy or window would not fit its column, the stacked layout is kept instead of clipping. Re-measured after fonts load and on resize.

beats.note: Entry is CSS-only (duck and session panel rise once); headline and CTA are never animated.

beats.section: One needs you. You know which.

timeline.state: receipt, then work steps stagger in until 0.98

beats.animates: opacity and transform only; rail fill scaleX 0..1 over the whole pin
beats.mobileFallback: four stacked states, session list shown only inside the first state's header-less compact window; all four story texts retained
beats.replay: button appears after 3% progress; scrolls to the pin start on request only
beats.transitions: old state leaves in the first half of each crossover, new one arrives in the second; copy leaves before and returns after the cut, so nothing overlaps

beats.note: smaller capture (max 1080px), numbered markers pop in once, plus a 'View full screenshot' link
each mood moves once on arrival (bob, startle, hop, settle); nothing loops

beats.section: Step away. Stay in the loop.

beats.note: Three assurances reveal; the long explanations and 5-row compatibility table sit in a native details/summary.
Static close: no scroll behaviour beyond normal flow.

budget.wheelNotchesTopToBottom: about 70 at 100px per notch; the nav 'Download' link and hero CTA make the primary action reachable in 0 notches, and End escapes the pin
budget.note: Heights sum to the page height (960+2475+1454+707+854+666+647+116).
